title: Carried Away | Real Joy
meta_description: Top Reasons to Book this Home:* 620 Feet to Private Gated Beach Access* Multiple Balconies * Community Pool is 25 yards from the House* Lovely Interior and Plenty of Space for your Group* Walk to Blue Mountain Beach Creamery and Redfish Village * 2.2 m
description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Home:* 620 Feet to Private Gated Beach Access* Multiple Balconies * Community Pool is 25 yards from the House* Lovely Interior and Plenty of Space for your Group* Walk to Blue Mountain Beach Creamery and Redfish Village * 2.2 miles to Gulf Place; 3 miles to Grayton Beach* Snorkel the Sea Turtle Reef-more info under Area Attractions below* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service *This property is NOT AVAILABLE for rent to those under the age of 25. No Exceptions. * Wake up to warm and plentiful Florida sunshine streaming through the windows at Carried Away! Enjoy the multiple balconies with views of the Gulf of Mexico on every level of the house. The property is spacious and ideally located just a short walk from a private beach, making it perfect for families. The property provides a wonderful view and features a community pool that feels almost private due to the limited number of houses sharing it. Prepare anything from your morning coffee to a delicious meal in your well-equipped kitchen with plenty of dining seating. You will find a queen guest bedroom 1 on the 1st floor, a king master bedroom, a king guest bedroom 2 a twin bunk nook on the 2nd floor, and a loft on the 3rd floor that has 2 twin beds. This beautiful home sleeps 10 comfortably. Relax on the balcony with your favorite drink as you watch the sunset. Come create unforgettable memories at Carried Away!The Bed Setup: 1st Floor:Guest Bedroom 1: Queen Bed2nd Floor:Master Bedroom: King BedGuest Bedroom 2: King BedBunk Nook: Twin Bunk Beds3rd Floor:Loft: 2 Twin BedsArea Attractions: This is a fantastic location with Gulf Place Town Center only 2 miles to the West and Watercolor, Grayton Beach, Seaside, Seacrest, and Rosemary Beach just minutes away to the East. Biking is a great activity to enjoy as the scenic bike path meanders along 30A. Bike over to Blue Mountain Beach Creamery for some homemade scoops that will have your taste buds coming back! 30A is a fantastic destination, the beaches are some of the world’s best with sugar white sand and emerald green waters. You will find plenty of beach accesses along a 17-mile stretch of Santa Rosa Beach. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine, and the incredible architecture that makes 30A famous, there are activities for everyone; kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, and tennis -- you'll find it all right here.The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Sea Turtle Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 783 feet out from the Grayton Beach State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Sea Turtle Reef is at a depth of 12-19 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
